description: Use this when the user gives the route and their vehicle (type and, for anything bigger than a car, its length, width and height) and wants an indicative price. Returns a rounded price range from the IVSS pricing engine (the same one as Instant pricing): sea freight, export handling and destination port costs, before import duty and taxes. Not a quote, no email, nothing is stored. For the exact itemised price use Instant pricing or request_exact_quote.

from_country.description: Country the vehicle ships from, e.g. "United Kingdom", "Germany"

height_m.description: Overall height in metres, including roof racks

length_m.description: Overall length in metres (optional for a car or 4x4)

to_country.description: Country it ships to, e.g. "United States", "Australia"

width_m.description: Overall width in metres, including mirrors

name: get_price_by_dimensions
title: IVSS indicative RORO price for this vehicle (by size)
